name: Himiko Masaki
source: As the Class V Student Body President of Yoshino High School, Himiko has a duty to protect her classmates and investigate threats to her school. When an unusual power awakens within her, Himiko sets off on a journey to find her missing mother and climb the ranks of Shinogi Chess in an effort to change the world.
